description: This source file implements functions for pruning packed objects in a Git repository, including removing duplicate objects and managing progress display during the process.

methods.name: int prune_subdir(unsigned int nr,const char * path,void * data)

methods.description: Callback for processing each object, prints commands in dry-run mode or removes objects from disk.

methods.description: Main function to prune packed objects based on provided options, manages progress display.
